headline: Growth remains in sight

highlights: Yet, EBITDA (up 28% YoY) matched our expectations, tracking strong margins, which were up 300bps YoY at 13.5% and were among the highest in over a decade.
Increased traction in sale of metro coaches (51 units vs. 30 in Q1FY27) and an unchanged guidance to deliver >200/275 such coaches in FY27/FY28 inspire confidence.
Also, the recent win of a large freight wagon order (4,955 units) from Indian Railways has increased visibility on the Freight segment (FRS).
While the prototype approval for the Vande Bharat (VB) train set has been pushed by a quarter (to Q4FY27), we continue to expect strong execution thereafter.
valuation: Factoring in attractive valuations at CMP (post the recent correction in the stock price), we update TRSL to BUY (from ADD) (valuing it at an unchanged 35x H1FY29E EPS).
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
